notes: **Fact.** Heat Q = mcΔT; specific heat c, thermal capacity C = mc, heat capacity per mole = C. molar.
**Fact.** Latent heat L: Q = mL (change of state at constant T). Calorimetry: heat lost = heat gained.
**Fact.** Newton's law of cooling: rate of heat loss ∝ (T − T₀); dθ/dt = −k(θ − θ₀).
